name: mise
description: Read your Mise leads, proposals, rooms and room availability. Read-only; sign in with your Mise account.

interface.longDescription: Mise is the event system for restaurants and venues. Connect it to see which leads still need a reply, which proposals are active, your rooms, and whether a room is free at a given time. Access is read-only: the assistant can't change records or send messages. An owner or manager signs in with their Mise account and can disconnect the assistant anytime in Mise under Settings, AI assistants.
defaultPrompt: Which Mise leads still need a reply?
Is our private dining room free next Saturday evening?
